DIAGNOSIS READY: Cytomegalovirus (CMV) Retinitis.

Based on your history of AIDS and the fundoscopy results showing granular yellow-white opacities and dot-blot hemorrhages, you have CMV retinitis. This is an urgent condition requiring immediate antiviral treatment to prevent permanent blindness. Do you have any history of recent systemic infections or flu-like symptoms?
